prompt:
You are a contributor to this repo. Read CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/capture-intent/SKILL.md and templates/intent.md first.

The workspace evals/out/01-intent-placeholder/ws/ holds idea.md, a field note written by a non-engineer. Turn it into an intent exactly at:

  evals/out/01-intent-placeholder/ws/intent/9001-eval-sample/intent.md

Rules: (1) follow the capture-intent skill's template, section for section, in the originator's words; (2) leave no ‹…› placeholder; (3) line 2 is `Author: … Status: draft.` — nobody has approved it, approval is the merge; (4) create or change nothing outside the workspace.
expected_output: One file, intent/9001-eval-sample/intent.md: the template's five sections filled from the note (61 of 214 calls · 3 min 20 s · within 10 minutes · C1 no new contact data · C2 50 req/s · Q1 which statuses · Q2 night sending), line 2 ends with `Status: draft.`, no placeholder left.
measures: Whether CLAUDE.md and the capture-intent skill steer the agent: an unsteered agent copies the template with placeholders left, or invents a frontmatter the template does not have.
assertions: The prose invents no fact (number, deadline, system name) that is not in the note
Problem states the observed counts, not a cause or a fix
Each open question names who can answer it
